sources.title: Chief Electoral Officer, Nagaland, press note No. ELE/REV-15/2026 of 20 September 2026 on the key findings of the enumeration phase
Chief Electoral Officer, Nagaland, SIR status report as on 13 September 2026, as carried by a Nagaland newspaper

notes: The state figures are from the Chief Electoral Officer, Nagaland's press note of 20 September 2026, the day the draft was published.
The note prints the three reasons and not their total. The names left off are the roll before less the 11,99,456 forms collected, and the three reasons add to exactly that.
The draft here is general electors. The note also counts 7,001 service electors, which brings the draft to 12,06,457.
The note prints the draft by sex, but the men and women it gives add up to the roll before the revision. Those figures are left out.

A district table of the Chief Electoral Officer is known only through the press. It is a status count of enumeration forms as on 13 September 2026, a day before house visits ended. It counted 1,57,451 forms that could not be collected, against 1,57,752 names left off at the draft. Its rows count forms and carry no reasons, so this page does not draw it.
The final roll is due on 22 November 2026.
cannot_show: How many names were left off the draft in each district or constituency. The Chief Electoral Officer has not released district figures for the draft.
Women's share of the names left off. The figures by sex in the press note do not add up.
How many electors were sent a notice. No count from the Chief Electoral Officer was found.
